items.summaryZh: 阿隆索在F1墨西哥大奖赛排位赛Q1因动力单元故障提前退赛，仅完成一个飞驰圈，排名第18。他表示自己的沮丧“超乎想象”。

items.originalTitle: Fernando Alonso 'beyond frustration' after engine issue in F1 Mexico GP qualifying
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso's qualifying for the F1 Mexico Grand Prix ended early in Q1 due to a power unit problem, leaving him 18th with only one flying lap completed. He said his frustration is "beyond imagination."
detailZh: 阿隆索在F1墨西哥大奖赛排位赛因动力单元故障提前结束后表示，自己的“沮丧超乎想象”。
这位阿斯顿·马丁车手原本有望进入Q2，但动力单元故障导致他在Q1提前退赛。
阿隆索表示，在动力单元故障导致他的F1墨西哥大奖赛排位赛提前结束后，他的“沮丧超乎想象”。
这位阿斯顿·马丁车手仅完成一个飞驰圈，排名第18；Q1还剩11分钟时，他的AMR26在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道的体育场路段停下。
对于这位两届世界冠军来说，这是一个令人心碎的时刻——他当时是11位车手中最快的，但最终却跌入淘汰区，距离Q2慢了0.387秒。
“所有人的温度都出了大问题，”阿隆索说。“所以，当你从后面起步时，根本没办法紧跟其他赛车之类的。”
“我们做不了什么。我觉得我们错失了一个大好机会。所以，是的，沮丧程度超乎想象。但这就是今年的写照。”
因此，阿隆索未能在五轮比赛中第三次晋级Q2——尽管自夏休前后阿斯顿·马丁为布达佩斯和赞德沃特带来升级以来，他的状态有所回升。
因此，当被问及在墨西哥是否甚至有可能进入Q3时，阿隆索——其队友斯特罗尔排位赛位列第20——表示：“大概很难。”
“我们当时是第12、第13、第11，所以我们在那个窗口里。如果跑出一圈好成绩，或许有可能，但我觉得那大概太乐观了。也许第13、第12就是我们今天的位置。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso 'beyond frustration' after engine issue in F1 Mexico GP qualifying
The Aston Martin driver was looking good for Q2 until a power unit problem caused an early retirement in Q1
Fernando Alonso stated that his “frustration is beyond imagination” after a power unit problem caused an early end to his qualifying for the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix.
The Aston Martin driver took 18th with only one flying lap as his AMR26 ground to a halt through the stadium section of Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez with 11 minutes left in Q1.
It was a gut-wrenching moment for the two-time champion who was fastest of 11 drivers at the time, before eventually dropping into the elimination zone and 0.387s off Q2.
“Huge problems with temperatures for everybody,” said Alonso. “So, when you start at the back, there is no way you can follow cars closely or something like that.
“There is not much we can do. I think we lost a big opportunity. So, yeah, frustration is beyond imagination. But this is the story of the year.”
Alonso was therefore denied a third progression to Q2 in five rounds having enjoyed an upturn in form since Aston Martin’s upgrades for Budapest and Zandvoort either side of the summer break.
So when asked whether even Q3 could have been possible in Mexico, Alonso, whose team-mate Lance Stroll qualified 20th, said: “Probably difficult.
“We were P12, P13, P11, so we were in the window. If we put a good lap, maybe it was possible, but I think that was probably too optimistic. Maybe P13, P12 was our position today.”
keyPointsZh: 阿隆索的AMR26在Q1还剩11分钟时于罗德里格斯兄弟赛道体育场路段停下
故障发生前他原本有望进入Q2
keyPointsEn: Alonso's AMR26 stopped in the stadium section of Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez with 11 minutes left in Q1
He had been looking good for Q2 before the problem

items.titleZh: 安东内利2026年将如何成为首位F1世界冠军的亮点
items.summaryZh: 如果20岁的安东内利在今天晚些时候的墨西哥大奖赛上赢得2026年的世界冠军，他将不仅仅成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。他的统计成绩已经超越了过去的首次夺冠者。
items.originalTitle: Where Antonelli's 2026 will stand out among first-time F1 titles
detailZh: 基米·安东内利如果，如看起来几乎确定的那样，在今天晚些时候的墨西哥大奖赛中赢得2026年的世界冠军头衔，他将不仅仅成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
这位20岁的年轻人只需要从剩余的比赛中再获得两个积分，相当于一个第九名的成绩，就能成为冠军，而他的数学上的竞争对手乔治·拉塞尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿实际上需要赢得本赛季剩余的所有比赛。
安东内利的赛季统计已经超越了过去首次夺冠的冠军们。
他将成为第36位F1世界冠军，但在那些冠军中，将有20位是在最后一轮决赛中赢得他们的首个冠军。相比之下，安东内利正在轻松地赢得冠军，并有望在19轮比赛后夺冠。这将是在完成了82.6%赛季的情况下，首次夺冠的车手中最快的第五位。即使本赛季减少到22轮，他也能保持这个位置，无论你如何调整计算。
那些领先的人中，有Nigel Mansell，他在39岁时终于赢得了他唯一的冠军，那是在1992年，当时赛季还剩下68.8%。然而，他是一位从1986年开始就参与冠军争夺的老将。年赛季的70和年赛季的72紧随其后。
唯一一个比安东内利赢得更快冠军的司机看起来将是年赛季的75，当时世界冠军赛是在F2机械上进行的。
安东内利有望成为过去30年中唯一三位在最后一轮之前就锁定他们第一个冠军的司机之一。这将使他加入阿隆索（2005年赛季的89.5%）和年赛季的94的杰出行列。
所有这些冠军都是在不同的机械和不同水平的对手中赢得的，但安东内利的胜利也显得有些轻松。即使在16次没有进行到最后一场比赛的首次冠军争夺中，也有一些是真正的冠军争夺战，在赛季深入进行后才偏向于某位车手。
例如，阿兰·普罗斯特在1985年为麦凯轮赢得的冠军是在剩下两场比赛的情况下锁定的，但法拉利的米歇尔·阿尔伯托与他并肩作战，却在最后五场比赛中未能得分。艾伦·琼斯（1980年）、巴顿、埃尔顿·塞纳（1988年）和阿隆索都是真正的战斗的一部分。
尽管你可以争论梅赛德斯的主导作用在其中起了很大作用，但拉塞尔在第二辆车的表现表明，如果没有安东内利的出色表现，这个赛季可能看起来会完全不同。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli will become more than just Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion if, as looks near-certain, he clinches the 2026 title at the Mexican Grand Prix later today.

The 20-year-old needs just two more points, equivalent to a single ninth place, from the remaining races to be champion, while remaining mathematical rivals George Russell and Lewis Hamilton effectively need to win all of the rest of this season’s races.
Antonelli’s campaign already stands out statistically against past first-time title winners.

He’ll be the 36th F1 world champion, but should be in a minority in that 20 of those clinched their first title in a final-race decider. Antonelli, by comparison, is cruising to the title and set to clinch it after 19 rounds. That will be with 82.6% of the season completed, by that metric the fifth-fastest of the first-time title-winners. He retains that position even if this season drops to 22 rounds, regardless of how you adjust the calculation.

Those ahead are led by Nigel Mansell, who finally won his only championship at the age of 39 in 1992 and sealed it with just 68.8% of the season gone. However, he was a veteran of title fights stretching back to 1986. Jim Clark (70% of the season in 1963) and Jackie Stewart (72.5% of the 1969 season) are next up.
The only other driver who won faster than Antonelli looks set to was Alberto Ascari (75% of the 1952 season) when the world championship was run for Formula 2 machinery.

Antonelli is poised to be one of only three drivers in the last 30 years who have sealed their first titles before the last round. That will put him in the illustrious company of Fernando Alonso (89.5% of the season in 2005) and Jenson Button (94.1% of the 2009 season).

All of these championships were won in different machinery against different levels of opposition, but Antonelli’s also stands out as something of a walkover. Even among the 16 first-time title wins that didn’t go down to the last round, some were genuine title fights that went deep into the season before swinging in one driver’s favour.

For example, Alain Prost’s 1985 championship for McLaren was sealed with two races to spare but Ferrari’s Michele Alboreto was right there with him before failing to score in the final five races. Alan Jones (1980), Button and Ayrton Senna (1988) and Alonso were all part of genuine battles.

And while you can argue the dominance of Mercedes played a big part in this, Russell’s performances in the second car show that it might have looked like a profoundly different season without Antonelli’s brilliance.
keyPointsZh: 安东内利只需在剩余的比赛中再获得两个积分，即一个第九名，就能成为冠军。
他将成为第36位F1世界冠军，但与那些在最后一轮比赛中夺冠的车手相比，他将是一个少数。
安东内利有望成为唯一一位在完成19轮比赛后，以82.6%赛季完成度夺冠的车手。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli needs just two more points from the remaining races to be champion.
He will be the 36th F1 world champion but will be in a minority among those who clinched their first title in a final-race decider.
Antonelli is poised to be one of only a few drivers to win the title after 19 rounds with 82.6% of the season completed.
